stories.title: Eight great new indie horror games for Halloween
summary: Whether you favour spooky fairtales, satanic card games or infernal hijinks at the chip shop there are all manner of fresh top scarers at large this witching seasonTis almost All Hallows’ Eve and naturally, the thoughts of all good video game players are turning to horror.
2026 has already been a bloody good year for the genre with Resident Evil Requiem and Silent Hill: Townfall leading the rabble.
But this autumn sees a festering surge of indie horror releases, featuring everything from cursed card games to Nazi-hunting penguins.

stories.title: CurrentBody Series 3 review: a fully customisable LED mask that helps exactly where you need it
summary: With six light wavelengths and almost endless ways to combine them, CurrentBody’s latest sets a new standard for red light therapy devices• The best LED face masksCurrentBody’s LED masks have long been my favourite.
My previous favourite, the now-discontinued CurrentBody Multi Light Therapy LED mask, offered five treatments that used different light wavelengths to address multiple skin concerns.

The company’s latest mask, the new Series 3, has the most detailed customisable treatments I’ve ever seen.This isn’t the first LED mask I’ve tried that allows its user to select different treatments for different areas of the face.

stories.title: Anthropic files for potentially record-breaking stock market valuation in key test for AI industry
summary: Market debut of firm behind Claude chatbot will be one of largest in US history, a test of AI boom’s financial viabilityAnthropic has publicly filed for a stock market listing in what is slated to be one of the largest debuts in history.

The company’s float on the US market will serve as a test of the financial viability of the multitrillion-dollar AI boom.Analysts and investors have valued the San Francisco-based company, founded in 2021, at more than $1.5tn.
The company, which will will list under the symbol ANT, confidentially filed with US financial regulators for an initial public offering in June.

stories.title: Sunlight at night: US startup’s demonstration of lighting Earth from space draws criticism
summary: Company imitates reflection of sun from mirrors, prompting pushback from some scientists, environmentalists and California localsLocals in a rural area of California were recently startled to see dazzlingly bright light shining down from nearby mountains at night, illuminating a swathe of the desert below.Unbeknown to them, the strange nocturnal illumination was the latest step in a company’s plan to erect thousands of giant mirrors in space to reflect sunlight on to the Earth during night-time.
